capabilities: List the registered construction families, commands and evaluators for this binary.
plan-sketch: Compute the supported arrangement, junctions and construction events before building a solid.
extrude-sketch: Extrude the admitted SolidCraft profile with the same planar layout as the preview and audit the result.
sketch-preview: Run the planar partition on a supported native sketch and export the internal edges as SolidCraft construction geometry.
build: Construct a versioned rational volume model from its family-specific recipe.
audit: Read the persisted model and repeat its family-specific checks on controls, incidence and geometry.
evaluate: Evaluate a homogeneous rational map at the three supplied parameters.
certify-map: Bound the determinant on the parameter cube under the leaf and depth budgets. Inspect the returned status and lower bound.
import-solidcraft: Import a supported SolidCraft script through the historical adapter.
import-solidcraft-sketch: Replay a supported design timeline through sketch and feature constructors.
inspect-travel: Inspect a travelling-bore configuration at the specified centre coordinate in micrometres.
crossed-boolean: Select an operation in the supported crossed-tool arrangement. The output retains its partial-face footprints.
compose-axial: Subtract a third axial operand from a connected two-operand union, carrying surviving source maps and face ownership.
annulus-edges: Emit the knots and homogeneous volume nets for an annulus layout and edge profile.
edit-s3-stock-rim: Apply the supported stock-rim treatment on the S3 plate and emit its JSON or STEP representation.
edit-fieldcraft-bore-rims: Apply the requested edge state to the qualified FieldCraft bore rims.
edit-bore-intervals: Apply a set of axial bore edits to the saved model with the family's edit and lineage checks.
assemble-patches: Apply a supplied layout to the source cells and assemble compatible homogeneous control nets.
plan-patches: Select a tensor-patch cover from the existing volume cells and retain the mapping of spans to sources.
cover-cylinder: Assemble a two- or three-volume cover of the tall three-layer cylinder, including its seam incidence.
reduce-axial-knots: Attempt exact geometry-knot removal on compatible axial chains. Retain source subintervals and selections.
export-step: Write the oriented boundary of an admitted model as STEP for independent CAD readback.
export-geometry-vtu: Sample the geometry at the requested subdivision count for a VTK viewer.
export-field-vtu: Sample the field from a supported result package for VTK visualization.
export-analysis: Construct the family's analysis package with the specified Gauss order.
export-sketch-analysis: Compile a sketch-derived analysis package at the requested integration order.
export-nurbs-space: Export the supported conforming rational field with shared trace numbering.
export-adaptive: Compile the local refinement plan into an adaptive analysis package and trace constraints.
classify-transverse-transitions: Examine first jets on interfaces and report the supported constant or affine transverse relations.
recover-spline-parent: Recover the strip's generating tensor-product parent and verify its restrictions.
recover-pair-parents: Test neighboring cell pairs for a common polynomial parent under the admitted parameter changes.
recover-translation-columns: Find supported chains of translated sections along the chosen axis.
spline-eligibility: Inspect which parent or field constructions the supplied model admits.
export-parent-field: Write the extracted canonical field for the recovered strip parent.
audit-parent-field: Check the serialized parent field against its geometric model.
check-parent-galerkin: Compare the fine and transferred parent stiffness at the same quadrature order.
export-parent-stiffness: Serialize the parent-field stiffness for independent matrix reassembly.
solve-parent-field: Solve an admitted parent-field elasticity job on the recovered strip.
export-inherited-space: Apply the requested continuity plan and serialize the constrained field.
audit-inherited-space: Recheck the saved inherited-space package and its constraints.
solve-inherited-space: Solve a supported mechanical job on a persisted inherited field.
solve-inherited: Construct the inherited field from the model and run the supported job.
refine-thb-strip: Apply the supported hierarchical refinement plan to the recovered strip and save a replayable package.
export-thb-extraction: Export element extraction data for the locally refined field.
check-thb-galerkin: Compare coarse stiffness with the transferred refined stiffness at identical quadrature.
solve-thb-strip: Select the prepared or locally refined field from a THB package and solve the job.
solve-job: Dispatch an elasticity job to the compatible model or saved field space.
differentiate-job: Differentiate an admitted job along the prescribed direction within one fixed regime.
crossed-bending: Solve the ten-chart crossed-tool bending study using the specified transverse and thickness subdivisions and Gauss order.
conforming-bending: Solve the recorded 22-chart fitted S2 elasticity control with the selected refinement, Gauss order and C0 or interior C1 field continuity.
